assessments.reasoning: The README title and opening paragraphs name CUE and its role. The same README directs readers to the official language specification. Its separate install section and the specification introduction distinguish language from tooling.

limitations: The identity covers the language. The README also covers installable project tooling and integrations, which have separate scopes.
